title: CodeStudio-Agent stdio task service protocol 2
description: UTF-8 JSON lines. Strict request parameters and extensible result records. x-maxBytes is a UTF-8 byte bound, unlike maxLength. Method results require request/response correlation. See protocol/README.md.
$comment: Runtime permissions, state/binding, paths, cron syntax/timezone and cross-field budgets remain authoritative. This schema does not imply safe retries or durable operation lookup.

credentialReference.description: Nonsecret credential reference. Model tasks pin the reference in their execution binding and resolve its current value once per run or resume.

runOptions.description: Explicit grants only. Provider configuration, paths, grants and execution bindings also require runtime validation; schema acceptance never authorizes execution.

resumeOptions.description: Omit stream to retain the saved mode. Resume requires the exact saved configuration and explicit permissions again.

schedulerLaunchParams.description: Supervision is opt-in. Limits require supervise=true; restarts are counted across the supervisor lifetime, with exponential delay capped at 60000 ms.

scheduleCreateParams.description: The command also requires deadline_ms > delay_ms, using defaults of 86400000 and 0.

taskSummary.description: Oversized stored fields are null with FIELD_omitted:true and FIELD_bytes. Status/provider strings remain extensible.

payload.description: Event-specific JSON selected by kind; outside this transport contract.

binding.description: Exact persisted execution binding. The checkpoint contract owns provider, policy, tools and configuration; this partial description must never reconstruct authorization.

schedulerStatus.description: Last-observed persisted state, not proof that a PID is alive.

manifest.description: Explicit build manifest version 2; governed by the workspace-build contract.

recipe.description: Full frozen version-2 recipe; never a client reconstruction.

actionReceipt.description: Arguments, results and continuation feedback are tool-specific JSON.

rpcError.description: unknown never authorizes replay. Recovery is an observation/control path, not a retry grant.

request.description: Requests carry IDs. Client notifications are ignored, never an invocation mechanism. Omitted params means an empty object only where permitted.

result.description: After ID correlation validate x-methods[request.method].result; responses do not repeat their method.

supervisorRecord.description: Durable lifecycle snapshot. Its phase and heartbeat are historical evidence, not proof of current liveness.

supervisorObservation.description: Read-only OS creation identity observation; never authorization to kill, restart or replay. Can become stale immediately.
